veranderings.rede: 'Die weer dophou' is the natural Afrikaans for keeping a watch on the weather; 'na die weer kyk' reads as one glance.

veranderings.voor: vrag gou oor lang afstande bring
veranderings.na: vrag gou oor lang afstande vervoer
veranderings.rede: 'Bring' needs a destination; 'vervoer' is the natural verb for carrying cargo over long distances.
'Gou te bring' leaves the sentence hanging without a destination; 'vervoer' completes it and matches the list item.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Brittanje het baie van hulle gevaar
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Transitive 'vaar' with a ship as object (sailing a ship) is uncommon in Afrikaans; 'met baie van hulle gevaar' or 'baie van hulle gebruik' would be more idiomatic. Left unchanged because it is protected.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Die vroegste seile kon net voor die wind loop.
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In the idiom it is the ship that 'loop voor die wind', not the sail; a reader may find 'seile ... loop' slightly odd. Left unchanged because it is protected.
